definitions.explanation: Having many bright colors. Used to describe objects, designs, clothing, and scenes that are visually vibrant.

examples.japanese: カラフルな⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
⟦マーケット→マーケット：00265_maaketto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カラフルな⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧や⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずらり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Colorful vegetables and fruits were lined up in rows at the market.

notes:
カラフル is a na-adjective from English 'colorful,' meaning having many bright, vivid colors. It always carries a positive nuance.

FORMS:
- カラフルな〜: colorful (modifier)
- カラフル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: colorfully (adverb)
- カラフルだ: is colorful (predicate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カラフルな⟦{色合|いろあ}い→色合い：13950_iroai⟧: colorful palette
- カラフルな⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧: colorful costume
- カラフルな⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧: colorful design
- カラフルな⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: colorful flowers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{色鮮|いろあざ}やか→色鮮やか：15312_iroazayaka⟧: vivid in color (more literary)
- ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧: flashy, gaudy (can be negative)
- ⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: colored (as opposed to black-and-white)

カラフル implies cheerful brightness. For gaudy or garish colors, use ⟦{派手|はで}→派手：03563_hade⟧ instead.
